# Well+Good

> > Well+Good is a digital wellness and lifestyle platform delivering daily news, health guidance, beauty trends, and astrology content through newsletters and subscription services.

Well+Good (formerly theSkimm) is a media brand that combines news, wellness, lifestyle, and entertainment content. The site serves readers seeking smartly curated information on health, beauty, spirituality, and cultural trends through multiple content formats including daily newsletters, podcasts, and interactive features.

## Homepage & Core

- [Well+Good Homepage](https://wellandgood.com/): Main entry point offering news, wellness, lifestyle content and subscription services

## Wellness & Health

- [Mental Health Guide](https://www.wellandgood.com/health/how-to-make-your-mental-health-better): Mental health guide covering wellness tips and lifestyle advice for improving emotional wellbeing

## Astrology & Spirituality

- [Weekly Horoscopes](https://www.wellandgood.com/astrology/weekly-horoscopes): Daily horoscopes for all zodiac signs with astrology readings and tarot interpretations

## Beauty & Shopping

- [Monoi Oil Beauty Guide](https://www.wellandgood.com/shopping/monoi-oil): Beauty product reviews and shopping guides featuring skincare and makeup trends
